turns.replyText:
How do I use it properly the very first time?

Perfect question! Here's how to get started with your Mesa Loop 30oz the right way 😊

Before First Use:

Wash everything - Take the lid apart (remove the straw and silicone plug) and wash the bottle and all lid parts. Top rack dishwasher safe, or hand wash with warm soapy water. Let it air dry completely.

Assembly: 2. Put the lid back together - Insert the straw back into the lid and twist it to lock it in place. Replace the silicone plug.

Using It: 3. Fill it up - Add your drink (cold or hot!) 4. Lock the lid - Click the button down to lock it closed (this keeps it leak-proof) 5. Unlock to drink - Click the button up to unlock and sip through the straw 6. Use the loop handle - Grab it with a finger and go!

Pro tip: The airflow relief valve helps with smoother sipping, so don't worry if you notice that little opening — it's supposed to be there!

That's it! Super simple. You'll get the hang of it in no time 💙
